assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and three key area polygons are provisional rough boundaries derived from announcement text extents and approximate areas, not official redline. They are suitable for concept generation, visualization, and local self-check but not for official redline, approval basis, or precise area calculation.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics (site area, land use areas, green ratio, etc.) are recomputed from provisional geometry in EPSG:4548 and must be recomputed end-to-end when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Five official regulatory control indicators (FAR, building height, building density, green ratio, setback) are missing from the cleared site package; no approved control values exist in public materials.
assumptions.impact: The proposal gives no control conclusions; indicative massing is for scale verification only. The five metrics are marked status=unknown in metrics.json.

assumptions.statement: Ownership, structure, and preservation value of existing buildings are not in public materials and must be determined by professional teams on-site.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classification cannot be concluded at parcel level; the proposal gives principles only.

assumptions.statement: Precise rail station placement, utility capacity, and heritage protection control lines must be determined by professional teams in conjunction with rail, utility, and heritage conditions.
assumptions.impact: The proposal makes no engineering conclusions on road alignment, rail alignment, bridge/tunnel, or utility pipelines.

assumptions.statement: Eight international AI evaluation cases (MLCommons, NIST AISI, UK AISI, Singapore AI Verify, BAAI FlagEval, CAICT, EU AI Act, SEMI) are background reference only with full provenance recorded in sources.json.
assumptions.impact: These cases inform the calibration concept but are not basis for local spatial conclusions or government commitments.
